newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index falls 0.39 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index falls 0.39 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.32 points, or 0.39 percent, higher at 82.37 points on Thursday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell 52.51 points to 3,598.37.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was up at 19.21 percent from 17.41 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
